verdict_rule: hyp_cells.verdict: design fold fixes the sign; confirm fold decides. CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE = confirm mean > 0, t >= 2, design mean > 0; FAILED_VARIANT = confirm mean <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE <= effect worth having; else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. SE over date blocks, MDE = 2.8 SE.

cells.title: Refiner outage lifts rival refiners' crack spreads
cells.refutation: If PADD-matched peers show no positive abnormal return vs distant peers in the 1-5 day window, the mechanism is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Compare peer refiners in same PADD vs refiners in distant PADDs; distant refiners should show no abnormal move, isolating regional supply shock from oil beta.

cells.title: Equity issuance dilution read-through to co-owned peers
cells.refutation: If the peer basket does not underperform cash-rich vol-matched controls the next session, or if the effect appears in cash-rich controls too, the hypothesis is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Peer basket should underperform cash-rich sector controls; effect should be concentrated in peers with high cash-burn similarity, not broad sector beta.

cells.title: Peer analyst downgrade spills over to thinly covered rivals
cells.refutation: If thinly covered peers show no differential negative return compared to well-covered peers after the downgrade, the hypothesis is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Compare returns of thinly covered peers to those of well-covered peers in the same sector, controlling for market and sector returns; the effect should be stronger for low-coverage names.
